newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Denway says restructuring in progress.
newsitem.headline: Denway says restructuring in progress.

text.p: Denway Investment Ltd said on Monday its major bankers have accepted in principle the group's proposals for restructuring.
The company said the restructuring would be completed soon, but did not provide a specific date.

Last week, Denway said Newman Overseas Ltd had completed the purchase of 72.8 percent of the company from Guangzhou Jinda Motors Holdings Enterprises and Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd at HK$0.465 per share.
Newman is indirectly held by Yue Xiu and Guangzhou Jinda Motors, which both are established as investment companies by the municipal government of the southern Chinese city of Guangzhou.
Denway owns a 95 percent interest in Guangzhou Auto Group Corp, which holds a 46 percent interest in Guangzhou Peugeot.
The company has reported substantial losses in recent years due in large part to financial difficulties at Guangzhou Peugeot.
